_doc: Sparks, the Lamplighters' dice (design/people/people-and-side-activities-spec.md §9; build item N-7.6.5): liar's dice with brass dice, you against one player. Each starts with `dice` dice; a bid is a count and a face across both cups ('three 5s'), ones (lamps) count as any face but are bid as themselves; each bid must be more dice, or as many on a higher face. Call 'dark' to open the cups: if the bid holds, the caller loses a die, if not the bidder does. Out of dice, out of the game. Each opponent: nerve (how far past what they can see they bid before they call dark: higher is bolder), bluff (the chance they bid a face they don't hold), stake (crowns a win pays; a loss costs it if you have it), tell (`tell` explains it, `sign` shows when their bid is a bluff; learned the first time you beat them, for every life), work (the game as a job: `wage` crowns and a rumour, half a day). Never played for coin without playing.
